name: Jack's Christmas
source:
Christmastime is here!
High school senior Jack plans to celebrate Christmas with his family and girlfriend, Jennifer. But Jennifer seems to be spending time around David, who was recently out of detention. What is David planning - and why is Jennifer involved without telling her Jack?

[From [url=https://christinan.itch.io/jacks-christmas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
聖誕節到了！
高中畢業班學生Jack打算和家人及女友Jennifer一起過聖誕節。然而，Jennifer似乎總和剛從拘留所出來的David待在一起。David有什麼打算？Jennifer又為何瞞著Jack與他來往？

[引自[url=https://christinan.itch.io/jacks-christmas]Itch.io[/url]]
